digest.component_or_area: plan-review / code-review gate cutover and execution kernel
propositions: A deterministic shadow comparator must consume the same call/result set as legacy and RP-06 projections and report only field-level mismatches against an approved delta allowlist, issuing no model calls and never controlling final verdict.

A repository-policy guard must prevent review gates from bypassing CriteriaSnapshot to read packaged/project routing directly, introducing a second discovery scheduler outside the shared kernel, or adding per-unit trace fields to review/review-status output schemas.

The real default plan-review and code-review discovery paths must reach configured providers (anthropic, openai, bedrock) with at least one provider call per arm, preserve narrow final verdicts (PASS/BLOCK), and retain reducer-ignored internal journals without printing secrets or prompt/context bodies.

New code must ignore legacy checkpoint envelopes; the retained compatibility projection cannot write new envelopes or decide final verdicts; rollback requires only a code revert without journal rewrite or data cleanup.

Cross-gate fixtures covering no overlay, effective disable/retune, scoped/global project LLM, project DET, budget shed, local/systemic failure, cancellation, and legacy checkpoints must produce approved final dispositions and trace outcomes.

The external provider matrix canary (tests/external/test_review_discovery_live.py) executed on all three provider arms on 2026-08-22, confirmed >=1 real discovery call per arm, and returned PASS verdicts with coverage.llm_ran=True and sidecar_emitted=True.
